title.en: Applied Pressure - psi: HBT80 16 Concrete Pump keeps Both print 6500 kg
title.zh: 施加的 压力 - psi：按水平 120 m 和高度 360 m 两个标题订 HBT80-16保留「是 50 m³/h。」

description.en: HBT80 16 Concrete Pump at /products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump. Both print 6500 kg HBT80-16 prints 1750 mm
description.zh: 按水平 120 m 和高度 360 m 两个标题订 HBT80-16见 /products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump。是 50 m³/h。都印 6500 kg。

h1.en: Keep HBT80 16 Concrete Pump under “Applied Pressure - bar” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「施加的 压力 - bar」下保留按水平 120 m 和高度 360 m 两个标题订 HBT80-16，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for HBT80 16 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump. Both print 6500 kg. HBT80-16 prints 1750 mm. 360 m is delivery height. 100 / 125 mm is on this page. The horizontal label is 120 m. The shipping line should keep 1750. Do not assume Electric 80 has the same cell. Electric 80’s frame width on its sheet is 1800 mm. /en/products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump/ to /en/contact/. Electric 80’s 900 m / 300 m pair is a different page. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110 as 110 kW, 50 m³/h, 40 MPa, horizontal conveying 120 m, delivery height 360 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm and 6500 kg. The section title “Applied Pressure - psi” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是按水平 120 m 和高度 360 m 两个标题订 HBT80-16的数字。要打开的行是 /products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump。是 50 m³/h。都印 6500 kg。360 m 是输送高度。水平标题是 120 m。运输行应保留 1750。不要假设电动80有同一格。100 / 125 mm 在这一页。HBT80-16 印 1750 mm。电动80表上的宽度是 1800 mm。电动80的 900 m / 300 m 是另一页。/zh/products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump/ 发到 /zh/contact/。河北品锦机械（邢台）把 HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110 印成 110 kW、50 m³/h、40 MPa、水平输送 120 m、输送高度 360 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm、6500 kg。节标题「施加的 压力 - psi」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: Under “Applied Pressure - psi”, HBT80 16 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. Both print 6500 kg. 100 / 125 mm is on this page. Do not assume Electric 80 has the same cell. Electric 80’s 900 m / 300 m pair is a different page.
body.zh: 在「施加的 压力 - psi」下，按水平 120 m 和高度 360 m 两个标题订 HBT80-16这一节只放已印出的格子。都印 6500 kg。100 / 125 mm 在这一页。不要假设电动80有同一格。电动80的 900 m / 300 m 是另一页。

body.en: “Applied Pressure - bar” titles this part of the HBT80 16 Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. HBT80-16 prints 1750 mm. The horizontal label is 120 m. Electric 80’s frame width on its sheet is 1800 mm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110 as 110 kW, 50 m³/h, 40 MPa, horizontal conveying 120 m, delivery height 360 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm and 6500 kg.
body.zh: 「施加的 压力 - bar」是按水平 120 m 和高度 360 m 两个标题订 HBT80-16这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。河北品锦机械（邢台）把 HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110 印成 110 kW、50 m³/h、40 MPa、水平输送 120 m、输送高度 360 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm、6500 kg。水平标题是 120 m。电动80表上的宽度是 1800 mm。/zh/products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump/ 发到 /zh/contact/。

heading.en: Example - Capacity in Compressed Air Pipe Line
heading.zh: 示例 - 能力 在 压缩 空气 管道 管线

body.en: For HBT80 16 Concrete Pump, the heading “Example - Capacity in Compressed Air Pipe Line” does not replace a cell. 360 m is delivery height. The shipping line should keep 1750. /en/products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump/ to /en/contact/. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/air-flow-compressed-air-pipe-line-d_1280.html.
body.zh: 对按水平 120 m 和高度 360 m 两个标题订 HBT80-16而言，标题「示例 - 能力 在 压缩 空气 管道 管线」并不替换任何格子。360 m 是输送高度。运输行应保留 1750。HBT80-16 印 1750 mm。是 50 m³/h。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/air-flow-compressed-air-pipe-line-d_1280.html。

question.en: Does “Applied Pressure - psi” replace Both print 6500 kg?
question.zh: 「施加的 压力 - psi」会替换「是 50 m³/h。」吗？

answer.en: No. Both print 6500 kg remains the printed wording for HBT80 16 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。是 50 m³/h。仍是按水平 120 m 和高度 360 m 两个标题订 HBT80-16已印的说法。

question.en: Where does HBT80-16 prints 1750 mm belong on the HBT80 16 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 按水平 120 m 和高度 360 m 两个标题订 HBT80-16这一行里，「都印 6500 kg。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Applied Pressure - bar” add to HBT80 16 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「施加的 压力 - bar」给按水平 120 m 和高度 360 m 两个标题订 HBT80-16增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/air-flow-compressed-air-pipe-line-d_1280.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/air-flow-compressed-air-pipe-line-d_1280.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
